title: Macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's eye condition.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for vision changes.

HPI
Pt is an 80-year-old female presenting for follow-up of vision loss in the right eye. Pt reports gradual decrease in central vision and distortion of objects. Pt states she has been seeing a blurry area in the center of her vision for several months. She denies sudden loss of vision, floaters, or flashes. Pt is here for evaluation of her macular degeneration.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Atorvastatin 20mg daily
Aspirin 81mg daily

Review of Systems
Constitutional: No fever, chills, or weight changes.
HEENT: Vision changes in RE. No ear pain.
CV: No chest pain, palpitations, or SOB.
Resp: No cough or wheezing.
GI: No abdominal pain or diarrhea.
MSK: No joint pain or swelling.
Neuro: No dizziness or syncope.

Social History
Retired. Lives with daughter. No tobacco or alcohol use.

Family History
Mother: Hypertension, stroke.
Father: Heart disease.

Vitals
BP: 138/84
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 97% on RA
Ht: 34%
WBC: 7.2
HbA1c: 6.4%
eGFR: 62

Exam
General: Alert, oriented x3. In no acute distress.
Eyes: RE: Funduscopic exam reveals exudative age-related macular degeneration. Notable disciform scar present. No active fluid noted. RE visual acuity decreased compared to baseline.
Neuro: Alert, coherent, intact.
Musculoskeletal: No acute injuries.

Assessment
1. Exudative age-related macular degeneration of the right eye.
2. Inactive scar noted on funduscopic exam.

Plan
1. Reviewed ophthalmology findings. Pt understands that the current condition is stable.
2. No injection needed at this time based on clinical stability.
3. Continue current medications.
4. F/u in 6 months for vision monitoring.

Electronically signed, T. Haddad, NP, 05/14/2026
explanations: Exudative (wet) AMD, right eye, with inactive scar: H35.3213 (HCC 300).

distractors.why: The wet AMD has an inactive scar, not active neovascularization.
The type, eye and stage are documented.
